source: Spark ~/handoffs/2026-10-19-site-inventory.md and .json (ledger L057). Every row carries a public link; a fact without a link is not on the page.
judging: Every number on this page is judged against two things only: the physical ceiling of the machine it ran on, and my own previous run. Nothing here is compared with anyone else's software.

ceilings.how: Memory ceiling, one token at a time: 273 GB/s nominal divided by 26,893,352,960 bytes of weights read per token. Arithmetic, not a measurement.

machines.name: NVIDIA DGX Spark
machines.detail: Grace Blackwell GB10, 128 GB unified memory, AArch64
machines.role: The development machine and the judge. Every speed receipt, every chip receipt, the verification pipeline and every agent run here.
machines.today: Linux. Serves Qwen3.8-27B (FP8) through my own server, aien-serve-http, on my own C GPU kernels, built inside the Omega project. The AienOS C kernel has not booted on the Spark; a Rust-era kernel booted once on 2026-09-24.

machines.name: Intel iMac 2017
machines.detail: iMac18,3, Core i5-7500 with 4 cores, 16 GiB, AMD discrete GPU, Broadcom Ethernet
machines.role: Bare metal AienOS, the x86_64 port of the C kernel. The whole screen is Aien's window: night sky, stars, black holes, Aien.
machines.today: Boots the kernel from its own disk or netbooted from the Spark as a signed image, and sends a boot report back over the network. The kernel it runs today is in the open iMac pull request stack, not yet on main.
machines.evidence: iMac batch run: all cores, both disks read, Ethernet seen (evidence/imac_kernel1_2026-10-17, on main)

machines.name: Raspberry Pi 5
machines.role: Two jobs: the first real hardware for the AArch64 AienOS C kernel, and the project's house server on Linux.
machines.today: Kernel runs are per test, from an SD image written for each run; no resident kernel is claimed. The house server runs readings-window, a read-only window onto the Spark's readings, and pi-register, the register of its services.
machines.evidence: Hardware runs: interrupts, four cores, user-mode tasks, scheduling, message passing, a log written to SD and read back (evidence/pi5_hardware_runs_2026-10-13, on main)

more.label: PR #402 ALLEN REFLEX on the Pi image (open)

machines.name: QEMU
machines.detail: AArch64 virt with AAVMF; x86_64 q35 with OVMF
machines.role: The emulator path. Every AienOS kernel gate runs here first, and QEMU qualifies nothing physical, by the repository's own words.
machines.today: Core-only and full AienOS kernel images for AArch64, the iMac kernel image for x86, the Atlas boot seed and the recovery images.
machines.evidence: 24 of 24 emulator gates PASS at 7f0de7e (receipt on main). The gate script now lists 26 gates, so a newer receipt is owed.

machines.name: Windows PC with an RTX 5070
machines.detail: 12 GB of GPU memory; the AIEN Rig target
machines.role: The target for AIEN Rig: a local AI engine in a 12 GiB budget, a Windows frame-rate tuner, speech to text, a creator helper and one Windows app.
machines.today: Nothing of mine has run on it yet. Every Rig artifact is built on GitHub Actions without a GPU, or measured on the Spark under a 12 GiB budget. There is no release tag yet.
machines.evidence: Rig engine receipts in a 12 GiB budget, measured on the Spark GB10, not on a 5070 (docs/inference/evidence/rig-engine-20261019)
